Ms. Chawadee Rungruang, Chief Financial Officer of BTS Group, Receives the 24th Outstanding Chulalongkorn Accountant Award 2025

Back 20 February 2026

The Alumni Association of the Faculty of Commerce and Accountancy, Chulalongkorn University, presented the 24th Outstanding Chulalongkorn University Accountant Award for 2025 to honor and recognise distinguished alumni who have achieved excellence in their professional careers. Ms. Chawadee Rungruang, Chief Financial Officer of BTS Group Holdings Public Company Limited (BTS Group), and an alumna of the Faculty of Commerce and Accountancy (Shi 55), was selected as one of the recipients of this prestigious award. The award ceremony was held at the Chulalongkorn Business Cinema on 29 January 2026.

The Outstanding Chulalongkorn University Accountant Award is presented to alumni of the Faculty of Commerce and Accountancy who have successfully applied their knowledge and expertise to achieve professional excellence, demonstrated integrity and ethical conduct, and made valuable contributions to the faculty, the university, society, and the nation.

BTS Group Holdings Public Company Limited is deeply proud of this achievement, which reflects Ms. Chawadee’s expertise, dedication, and strong commitment to her role. Her leadership continues to strengthen financial management in accordance with good governance and transparency, support the sustainable growth of the BTS Group while reinforcing confidence among stakeholders.
